description: Defines nested classes, structs, and an abstract class related to source line resolution in the Google Breakpad project, including types for source lines, functions, symbols, and a module interface.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverBase::AutoFileCloser
classes.description: Manages automatic closing of FILE pointers.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverBase::Line
classes.description: Represents a source line with address, size, file ID, and line number.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverBase::Function
classes.description: Represents a function with name, address, size, and parameter size.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverBase::PublicSymbol
classes.description: Represents a public symbol with name, address, and parameter size.

classes.name: SourceLineResolverBase::Module
classes.description: Abstract interface for source line modules, including methods for loading maps, address lookup, and retrieving frame info.

methods.name: LoadMapFromMemory
methods.description: Loads a symbol map from a memory buffer.

methods.name: IsCorrupt
methods.description: Checks if the symbol data is corrupt.

methods.name: LookupAddress
methods.description: Fills a StackFrame with information for a given address.

methods.name: FindWindowsFrameInfo
methods.description: Returns Windows frame info for a given stack frame, if available.

methods.name: FindCFIFrameInfo
methods.description: Returns CFI frame info for a given stack frame, if available.

methods.name: ParseCFIRuleSet
methods.description: Parses a CFI rule set into a frame info object.
